title: ElevenLabs API Quickstart: Your First Text to Speech Call in Python
desc:
Your first ElevenLabs API call, in Python, from the official quickstart. This episode covers creating an API key and keeping it in an environment variable, installing the elevenlabs SDK and python-dotenv, the text to speech convert call line by line with eleven_v4 and mp3_44100_128, the same request from the CLI, sending fields the SDK does not define yet, and three security practices: service accounts, expiring keys and resource-level permissions.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
